objective: Load current presentation metadata, all four raw acquisition economics fact families, and durable outcome facts exactly once for one explicit canonical relationship cohort without aggregation or cutoff filtering.

readPlan.concurrency: all six reads share one Promise.all boundary

rules: Relationship IDs are canonically validated and deduplicated while preserving first occurrence order.
Malformed requested relationship identity fails before any persistence read.
Empty relationship cohort performs zero downstream persistence reads.
Non-empty relationship cohort performs exactly six canonical batch reads.
Presentation, acquisition cost, premium, commission, renewal, and durable outcome reads receive the identical canonical relationship cohort.
All returned presentation and fact relationship identities must belong to the requested cohort.
At most one presentation may be returned for a relationship.
Raw evidence array order and object identity are preserved; this layer performs validation only.
No cutoff filtering occurs here; INS-004K remains sole owner of occurredAt < asOfExclusive semantics.
No relationship economics aggregation occurs here.
No dimension grouping, outcome analytics, cost-per-outcome calculation, current-status inference, currency conversion, or display formatting occurs here.
The D1 factory composes only existing canonical presentation, economics, and outcome readers.
No new SQL, schema, persistence mutation, migration execution, deployment, dashboard UI, or telephony activation is introduced.
explicitlyDeferred: as-of combined created-at acquisition performance snapshot
